learned_patterns.name: Split build-vs-adopt by layer, not as one decision
learned_patterns.context: Large subsystems where a single adopt/build choice forces a bad answer
learned_patterns.pattern: Build the domain engine; adopt narrow, well-licensed libraries for solved sub-problems. Report Engine built the engine and adopted NCalc, QuestPDF, Open XML SDK, ClosedXML and ScottPlot.

learned_patterns.name: Align documents to the as-built schema when the as-built is better
learned_patterns.context: A drafted schema and a schema the client already deployed had diverged
learned_patterns.pattern: Compare formally, produce a reconciliation document plus a machine-readable manifest, and add only the genuine gap fields additively. Teardown was rejected because the deployed model was more correct than the draft.

learned_patterns.name: Raise residency and compliance at architecture time
learned_patterns.pattern: Data residency, PDPPL sign-off and tenant type are named gates in the architecture document with an owner, not findings discovered in the audit phase. They have blocked go-live on four engagements.

common_mistakes.mistake: Designing configuration that carries record GUIDs across orgs
common_mistakes.symptom: Navigation and lookup config works in dev and silently no-ops elsewhere
common_mistakes.prevention: Resolve by code, name or alternate key at runtime. Constitution Article V applies to identifiers, not just business rules.

common_mistakes.mistake: Assuming a cache path and a live path stay equivalent
common_mistakes.symptom: A model transform dropped fields on the cache path only; cloud masked it for weeks
common_mistakes.prevention: When two read paths serve the same contract, require a parity test between them in the architecture, not as a QA afterthought.

preferred_approaches.scenario: A feature whose schema is gated on stakeholder approval
preferred_approaches.approach: Design the read path to degrade gracefully when the table is absent, so the gate is a data decision rather than a code branch.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Keeps one binary valid across provisioned and unprovisioned orgs and lets build proceed while the gate is open.

preferred_approaches.scenario: Any deviation from the default stack
preferred_approaches.approach: ADR in projects/<name>/adrs/, numbered, with the rejected options and their licences stated.
preferred_approaches.rationale: Constitution Article II. Licence traps (EPPlus v5+ Polyform, iText7 AGPL) are only caught if alternatives are written down.
